tools.name: run_authority_check
tools.description: Runs a free Authority Check from MilanAura AI Studio on a professional's public profile, such as a LinkedIn headline, About section and experience. Returns what is already working, the Authority Starting Point band, the biggest visibility gap, the first practical action, and one authority post writt

tools.name: get_authority_check_result
tools.description: Returns the result of an Authority Check started with run_authority_check. Waits up to about 40 seconds. If the check is still running, call this again with the same check_id. Each result can be retrieved once and is discarded after 10 minutes.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_authority_check · Public sink: run_authority_check · Destructive: run_authority_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_authority_check · Public sink: run_authority_check · Destructive: run_authority_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
